THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. KE/BLT/2022/89 and dated 31.05.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Panapitiya in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 107D Panapitiya in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Bulathkohupitiya in the District to Kegalle in Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Parawaththa – Extent: 0.1012 Hectare North: Parawaththa ; East; Parawaththa; South: Road; West: Road and Parawaththa.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/03.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.15th November, 2023.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments described in following names and extents depicted in Advance Tracing No. KE/BLT/2022/88 dated 31.05.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Erabuduwala in Grama Niladhari Division No. 108A of Haloluwa in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Bulathkohupitiya in the District of Kegalle in Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Dawatagahayata Kumbura and edge of Kosgahayata – Extent: 0.0152 Hectare North: Dawatagaha Yata Kumbura and Kosgahayata kanati; East; drain which was dug; South: drain which
was dug; West: Road and Dawatagahayata Kumbura and Kosgahayata Kanati:
02. Lot ‘B’ – Madakanda – Extent: 0.0042 Hectare North: drain which was dug ; East; Road (Pradeshiya Saba) ; South: Road (Pradeshiy Saba) ; West: Medakanda and drain which was dug.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/145.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.15th November, 2023.
